user.title: Connect Foodisco
user.description: Open Foodisco → Profile → Integrations → Home Assistant and create a pairing code. Enter it here. The code works for 10 minutes and only once.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect Foodisco again
reauth_confirm.description: The access was revoked or is no longer valid. Create a new pairing code in the Foodisco app and enter it here.

error.invalid_code: This code is wrong, expired or already used. Create a new one in the app.
error.cannot_connect: Foodisco could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Foodisco account is already connected. The access was refreshed.
abort.wrong_account: This code belongs to a different Foodisco account.

report_event.name: Report event
report_event.description: Tell Foodisco that something happened at home, for example that the oven is done. Foodisco then decides whether to ask what you cooked.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Foodisco account to tell. Only needed when several people are connected.

choose_account.message: Several Foodisco accounts are connected — choose one.

reauth_needed.message: The Foodisco access is no longer valid. Connect again in Settings → Devices & services.

rate_limited.message: Foodisco asked to slow down. Try again in a moment.
